name: Confidential Money ~300-nichi de 3000-man Dollar Kasegu Houhou~
original_name: Confidential Money ～300日で3000万ドル稼ぐ方法～
source:
The story starts in New York when an invitation letter from a mysterious figure called ‘John’, made its way into the hands of the heroine and six other males. The letters all bear the mysterious message: 'You have gained the right to win big money.' After that, following John’s instructions, they joined together to form CM7 (Confidential Money 7). With six individualistic members, the heroine, Natalie, work together to seize the business's off-the-books $30 million, and gradually, bridge the gap between their hearts.

[From [url=http://konnistique.tumblr.com/post/19988159586/confidential-money-how-to-earn-30-million-in-300]Konnistique's Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
故事从纽约开始，一封来自神秘人物“约翰”的邀请信到了女主角和另外六名男性手中。信上都写着同样神秘的信息：“你已获得赢得巨款的资格。”之后，按照约翰的指示，他们联合起来组成了CM7（Confidential Money 7）。女主角娜塔莉与六位性格各异的成员合作，争取企业的3000万美元秘密资金，并逐渐拉近了彼此内心的距离。

[来自[url=http://konnistique.tumblr.com/post/19988159586/confidential-money-how-to-earn-30-million-in-300]Konnistique's Tumblr[/url]]
